Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: StressWatch's paywall offer moment - the plan screen gives way to a Special Offer sheet where a purple starburst "25% OFF" badge scales up with a springy overshoot while the yearly total and fine print fade in.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Lavender Special Offer screen: "Special Offer" eyebrow with subcopy, a large purple starburst badge reading "25% OFF", "Total ₹ 1,499.00/year" with struck-through original price, "View All Plans" link, purple Continue button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: springy discount badge pop.
- Screen background tints to lavender (250ms) as the eyebrow text fades in (200ms).
- The starburst scales from 0 to 1 with a pronounced overshoot (spring ~300/14, ~550ms - visibly bounces past full size twice) and rotates ~8deg on the way in.
- Small sparkle accents around the badge pop in sequence (scale + fade, 150ms each, 3 sparkles).
- Pricing block ("Total ₹ 1,499.00/year", struck original, trial note) fades + rises 10px (300ms) once the badge settles; View All Plans and Continue follow 100ms later.
- Badge then idles with a subtle pulse (scale 1 -> 1.03, 2.2s loop).

## Calibration
- The overshoot is the point: a badge that lands cleanly reads flat.
- Struck-through price appears with the total - never after.

## Reduced motion
Badge fades in at full size; no rotation or pulse.

## Don't miss
- The badge is a jagged starburst shape, not a circle - keep the spiky silhouette.
- The whole sequence lands in under 1.5s; it should feel instant but playful.
